name: ajaia-docs
description: Ajaia Docs — a lightweight collaborative document editor (React + TipTap, Express + Drizzle, Postgres).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @ajaia/api" "npm run dev -w @ajaia/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ajaia/api && npm run build -w @ajaia/web
